trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum asks for the other 54 trophies, all earned offline in single-player with no difficulty setting to worry about (PowerPyx). PowerPyx rates the list 4/10 at about 200 hours; Push Square budgets 250+ hours (Push Square). Exophase shows the official split of 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver and 46 bronze (Exophase), and TrueTrophies counts 28 of the 55 as secret (TrueTrophies).

steps.text: Play the five-chapter story first: progress made there already counts toward 100%.
Keep a manual save at the start and end of every chapter, 10 of the 15 slots, because there is no mission replay.
Do Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 before the chapter closes.
After the credits, work the checklist under Touch Pad > Progress > 100% Completion.
Finish with Strangers & Freaks and leftovers; never enter a cheat on this save, it blocks trophies and saving.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.missableNote: Slot 1 of PowerPyx's 10-save plan: Chapter 1 start. The balcony meditation comes later in this chapter.
trophies.guide: Story trophy for Gone Fishing, the first main mission of Chapter 1 (PowerPyx). IGN's walkthrough has Jason and Cal pulling dropped cocaine bricks out of the Leonida Keys from a Lure Predator boat (IGN Wiki). It unlocks as part of the story (Push Square), so the real job here is starting the save routine.

steps.text: Start Chapter 1; Gone Fishing begins on its own.
Drive the Lure Predator to the dropped package; pause and open the Map to see where it is.
Finish the mission; the trophy unlocks with it.
Make manual save slot 1 now: your Chapter 1 start.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.missableNote: Slot 2: Chapter 1 end. After this point the Chapter 1 balcony meditation is gone for good.
trophies.guide: The text says Complete Chapter 1, but PowerPyx reports it popping after the first Chapter 2 mission, What's in the Bag? (PowerPyx). IGN lists 11 Chapter 1 missables, from Macizo Cigars to Get Shirley's Rum, none of them trophies (IGN Wiki). The one that matters is the balcony meditation, which has to be done before you leave (PowerPyx).

steps.text: Before the last Chapter 1 mission, confirm the balcony meditation shows in Progress.
Optional: clear IGN's Chapter 1 missables such as Get Shirley's Rum; none affect trophies.
Play into Chapter 2 and finish What's in the Bag?.
Nothing extra is needed: it unlocks as part of the story.
Save to slot 2 (Chapter 1 end) and never overwrite it.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.missableNote: Slot 4: Chapter 2 end. Keep it before the move to Vice City.
trophies.guide: Chapter 2 story trophy; PowerPyx reports it after Welcome to Vice City, the first Chapter 3 mission (PowerPyx). Push Square lists it as a plain story unlock (Push Square). The asterisks are part of the official name as PlayStation lists it (Exophase).

steps.text: Coffee Break in Chapter 2 opens partner free roam: Hot Together, Retail Therapy and Personal Best start here.
Finish Chapter 2, then play Welcome to Vice City.
It unlocks as part of the story.
Save to slot 4: Chapter 2 end, before the move to Vice City.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.missableNote: Slot 6: Chapter 3 end, right before Chapter 4 begins.
trophies.guide: Chapter 3 story trophy; PowerPyx has it after Ocean Beach and Another Life, the first two Chapter 4 missions (PowerPyx). Push Square lists it as a story unlock (Push Square). Chapter 3 is also where Andy, Randy, Tyrone, the Key Cloner and the Snap Gun arrive (PowerPyx).

steps.text: Chapter 3 opens Andy (Lucia only), Randy's Wish List and Tyrone (Jason only); accept each strand.
Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS gives the Key Cloner; Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives the Snap Gun.
Play Ocean Beach and Another Life at the start of Chapter 4.
It unlocks as part of the story.
Save to slot 6: Chapter 3 end.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.missableNote: Slot 8: Chapter 4 end, after Starting From Zero.
trophies.guide: Chapter 4 story trophy, tied by PowerPyx to the last Chapter 4 mission, Starting From Zero (PowerPyx). Push Square lists it as a story unlock (Push Square). Chapter 4's optional That's Where The Money Is… opens bank vaults and armored trucks, so play it when it appears (PowerPyx).

steps.text: Play That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe) when it appears; it starts vault robberies.
Headliners, VCIA Takedown and Child's Play all fall in this chapter.
Complete Starting From Zero.
It unlocks as part of the story.
Save to slot 8: Chapter 4 end.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.missableNote: Slot 10: the pre-finale save. No mission replay means this is the only way back.
trophies.guide: Gold for finishing the final story mission (Exophase). Free roam carries on afterwards but there is no mission replay (PowerPyx), and the 100% Completion checklist becomes visible once this trophy pops (Push Square).

steps.text: Keep slot 10 as a pre-finale save; it is your only way back into the story.
Play the final mission through the credits; the official text asks nothing more.
You can keep exploring Leonida after the credits.
Open Touch Pad > Progress > 100% Completion: the checklist is now live.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.missableNote: Slot 3: Chapter 2 start. Breakfast Run and Coffee Break follow in this chapter.
trophies.guide: Story trophy for Breakfast Run in Chapter 2 (PowerPyx). IGN's walkthrough starts at the motel where Jason is recovering and points you to Hank's Waffles in north Port Gellhorn (IGN Wiki). It unlocks as part of the story (Push Square).

steps.text: Save to slot 3 at the start of Chapter 2.
Breakfast Run (Check on Jason) starts back at the motel.
IGN advises a save before the drive to Hank's Waffles.
Finish the mission; it unlocks as part of the story.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.missableNote: Slot 5: Chapter 3 start, before The Cartel Heist.
trophies.guide: Story trophy for The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3 (PowerPyx). Push Square lists it as a story unlock (Push Square). Credit Check earlier in the chapter also unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer you need for Dime on the Dollar (PowerPyx).

steps.text: Save to slot 5 at the start of Chapter 3.
Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer for laundering.
Complete The Cartel Heist; the official text asks nothing more.
It unlocks as part of the story.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.missableNote: Slot 7: Chapter 4 start, before Child's Play.
trophies.guide: Story trophy for Child's Play in Chapter 4 (PowerPyx). Push Square lists it as a story unlock (Push Square).

steps.text: Save to slot 7 at the start of Chapter 4.
Child's Play is a Chapter 4 main mission.
Complete it; the official text asks nothing more.
It unlocks as part of the story.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy for Headliners, a Chapter 4 main mission (PowerPyx). Push Square lists it as a story unlock (Push Square).

steps.text: Headliners is a Chapter 4 main mission; keep your slot 7 save from the chapter start.
Vault robberies from That's Where The Money Is… can be done around it.
Complete Headliners; the official text asks nothing more.
It unlocks as part of the story.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy for VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4 (PowerPyx). Push Square lists it as a story unlock (Push Square). It is separate from Catch Me If You Can, which needs a stolen passenger plane at VCIA (PowerPyx).

steps.text: VCIA Takedown is a Chapter 4 main mission.
It does not count for Catch Me If You Can; that one needs a plane from a boarding bridge.
Complete VCIA Takedown; the official text asks nothing more.
It unlocks as part of the story.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.missableNote: Slot 9: Chapter 5 start, before Operation Savage Glory.
trophies.guide: Story trophy for Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5 (PowerPyx). Push Square lists it as a story unlock (Push Square).

steps.text: Save to slot 9 at the start of Chapter 5.
Operation Savage Glory is a Chapter 5 main mission.
Complete it; the official text asks nothing more.
It unlocks as part of the story.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The checklist opens after the story under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion and sits near 60% true completion, all doable in free roam (PowerPyx). IGN lists the bars, from 42 range golds to 300 stunts (IGN Wiki); 15 of 18 card sets is enough (Push Square).

steps.text: Finish the story; earlier progress already counts.
Complete any 100 Optional Missions as they appear.
Scan 200 of 277 vehicles; study 100 of 255 animals.
Clear 300 stunts, 70 challenges, 42 range golds.
Track it in Touch Pad > Progress > 100% Completion.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Any 250 of 397 stunts across four types: 130 Stunt Jumps, 202 Under the Bridges, 40 Knife Flights and 25 Base Jumps (PowerPyx). The extra challenge on each jump is optional (Push Square), and the 100% checklist wants 300 anyway (IGN Wiki).

steps.text: Mix any of the four types; PowerPyx rates Under the Bridges the quickest.
Track by region in Touch Pad > Progress > Activities > Stunts.
Find spots on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots.
Keep going to 300 for the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of 9 activity types once (Push Square): fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball hoops, a video game, a race or drone race, and a stunt (PowerPyx). IGN notes one Top Fun drone race covers the race slot (IGN Wiki).

steps.text: Open Touch Pad > Progress > Activities to see which types are done.
Filter the map for Activities (blue dumbbell) to find the rest.
Try one Top Fun drone race to tick the race slot.
Most of the nine happen naturally during the story.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges (Push Square). IGN maps 12 ranges across two hubs, Rodgers Ranch in Port Gellhorn and Griffin Shooting Range in Balsero (IGN Wiki). PowerPyx links the same 12 ranges and 42 golds (PowerPyx).

steps.text: Rodgers Ranch charges a $5 waiver; only 3 of its 6 ranges open on the first visit.
Start on the free Market Range, then unlock the rest.
Most challenges have three tiers, each needing gold; check locked ones on the map.
Range sessions also raise Focus, which makes Gunslinger easier.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations (Push Square). PowerPyx counts 42 drone races across those 14 sites (PowerPyx), and IGN says all 42 are needed for 100% (IGN Wiki).

steps.text: Find sites under Touch Pad > Activities > Drones > Top Fun Drones.
Some sites charge an entry fee.
Win at least one race at each of the 14 locations.
Clear all 42 for the 100% checklist while you are there.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races; winning the same one twice counts once (Push Square). IGN's race guide covers 39 races with buy-ins and rewards (IGN Wiki), and PowerPyx links 40 unique race locations (PowerPyx).

steps.text: Track races under Touch Pad > Activities > Racing.
Hire a car at the venue, or raise your own car's Rating at a Mod Shop.
Check IGN's list for buy-in prices before travelling.
Pick 20 of the roughly 40 venues PowerPyx maps.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After Chapter 1's Feng Shui (Meet Cal), Cal texts you a purple fishing marker (PowerPyx). Push Square says he wants a Parrotfish over 2 kg, caught from a boat with a rod (Push Square). IGN's fishing guide maps hotspots for all 35 species (IGN Wiki).

steps.text: Finish Feng Shui (Meet Cal) in Chapter 1, then wait for his text.
Head to the purple fishing icon.
Take or hijack a boat with a fishing rod nearby.
Land a Parrotfish over 2 kg.
Use IGN's hotspot maps if the bites are slow.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish every level of any one of four games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind or Bang For Your Buck (PowerPyx). The first three run on the TV at home from Chapter 1 (PowerPyx); IGN describes each game and its challenges (IGN Wiki).

steps.text: Use the controllers at the home TV; three games are there from Chapter 1.
Bang For Your Buck is on arcade machines around the map.
Reach the end of one game; its side challenges are optional.
IGN's game pages explain what each one asks of you.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's strand is Lucia-only: a call during Chapter 3, then a Belville address (PowerPyx). Push Square: it pops after all of Andy's missions (Push Square).

steps.text: Play as Lucia in Chapter 3 and take Andy's call.
Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1-3), then Pay the Cellerica Fee.
Peach! and Read the Label.
Puff Puff Pass ends the strand.
Finishing every Andy mission is the trigger.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's dive strand opens after Island Dreams in Chapter 1 and covers 7 shipwrecks (PowerPyx). IGN counts 41 treasures across those 7 dive sites (IGN Wiki); Push Square names Maritime Disputes as the final mission (Push Square).

steps.text: After Island Dreams (Work for Kenton), wait for his call; his KR icon is in Key Lento.
Dive the purple chest markers; use the metal detector on the sea floor.
Track the 41 finds in Progress > Collections > Kenton's Treasures.
He pauses after Chapter 1 and texts Jason again in Chapter 2-3.
Finish Maritime Disputes to unlock it.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's strand appears after Chapter 2's Coffee Break at Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County (PowerPyx); the last mission is Hometown Heroes (Push Square).

steps.text: After Coffee Break, head to Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County.
Thrillbillies, then Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab.
Mall Rats and The Impaler.
Hometown Heroes is the final mission.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Eight stranger strands. Many side strands do not count, including Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie (PowerPyx). Confirmed so far: Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete (PowerPyx). The PS5 trophy carries its own 8-strand counter (Exophase).

steps.text: Kirk: Skunk Apeology 101, Tree Effigies, Advanced Skunk Apeonomics.
Kyle: McKittrick Farm, Collect Chemicals, Buddy?.
Yago: Join a Street Race, Bumper to Bumper, Race Against Yago, Brother to Brother.
Pilot Pete: Passing the Torch, Backseat Pilot, Pete's Deliveries.
Watch the 8-strand counter on the PS5 trophy for the rest.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's Wish List opens with Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS in Chapter 3 and asks for 16 sports cars (PowerPyx). It pops after all of Randy's missions (Push Square).

steps.text: The Zorrusso is delivered during Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS.
Scan high-end cars with WAiNK to see if they are on his list.
Vice Beach and Ocean Beach hotels are good hunting spots.
Deliver every car on the list to finish his missions.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone appears after Here, Kitty Kitty in Chapter 3, Jason only (PowerPyx). It pops after all of Tyrone's missions (Push Square).

steps.text: After Here, Kitty Kitty, play as Jason.
Destroy the purple-marked Kitty Litter labs in Vice City.
Then play Spin On This (Shut Down the Labs).
Finishing every Tyrone mission is the trigger.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missableNote: After Down to Earth, accept Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house. It is gone once Chapter 1 ends, with no mission replay.
trophies.guide: 18 meditations at 10 locations; a spot done as both Jason and Lucia counts twice (PowerPyx). The first exists only in Chapter 1, at Jason's house after Down to Earth (Beebom); it is unclear if the trophy needs it, so do it (PowerPyx). A spot counts once the zen animation ends (Push Square).

steps.text: Finish Down to Earth (Meet Brian), after Buck Me.
Next morning, follow Lucia to the balcony; pick Accept.
Let the zen animation finish before moving.
Check Progress > Collections > Exploration.
Do the rest; the 18th, Mount Kalaga, shows last.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret texts Jason after Chapter 2's Coffee Break; his first quest, Veteran Hunted, is in Lummox County (PowerPyx). PowerPyx has not yet confirmed which animal triggers it, but all 15 Target Decks are needed for 100% anyway (PowerPyx). It is a visible bronze on the PS5 list (Exophase).

steps.text: Play Veteran Hunted (Meet Bret) as Jason.
Collect his Killtelligence SM-69 rifle from any Ammu-Nation locker.
Track hunts under Map > Activities > Target Deck.
Clear all 15 decks; the trophy comes along the way.
Visible on PS5, so this page reveals no secret trophy.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 of the 18 card sets (Push Square). IGN counts 481 cards across those sets, with a page per set (IGN Wiki); PowerPyx links all 18 set guides (PowerPyx).

steps.text: Pick three small sets from IGN's set pages.
Track sets in Touch Pad > Progress > Collections > Collectible Cards.
Cards sold at a Pawn Shop still count.
100% needs 15 sets, so this pops on the way.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK spots; IGN counts 108 to choose from (IGN Wiki). Push Square lists 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities, 23 Sculptures plus No Flusher Tags (Push Square). Any 100 will do (PowerPyx).

steps.text: When the WAiNK prompt shows, press D-pad Up and hold R1 to scan.
Mix Landmarks, Curiosities, Sculptures and No Flusher Tags.
Check Touch Pad > Progress > Collections > WAiNK Locations.
Any 100 count; the 100% checklist asks for the same 100.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: 80 challenges exist; 50 unlock this and 70 are needed for 100% (Push Square). PowerPyx suggests leaving it late, since many clear on their own (PowerPyx); IGN lists every challenge (IGN Wiki).

steps.text: View them under Touch Pad > Progress > Challenges.
Leave it for late; many clear while you do other trophies.
Pick quick ones from IGN's list, such as Speed Kills: 3 kills in 30 seconds.
Push on to 70 for the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Possible once Chapter 2's Coffee Break lets Jason and Lucia free-roam together (PowerPyx). Reach 4 stars with your partner and leave the red heat zone (PowerPyx); IGN's wanted guide covers clearing heat (IGN Wiki).

steps.text: Call your partner, then cause trouble until you reach 4 stars.
Escape on a fast motorbike, or via the train tunnel north of Ambrosia.
It counts once you leave the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area.
Use IGN's wanted guide for ways to clear heat.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops in a row with your partner while keeping the flashing wanted level; possible after Coffee Break (PowerPyx). The official text says back-to-back with your partner, so stay together (Exophase).

steps.text: Bring armor, sticky bombs and Zombix or Adrenaline.
Use the three Vice City jewelry stores, open after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs.
Keep the flashing wanted level; do not let it drop to heat.
It pops about 30 seconds after the third shop.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles: scanning with WAiNK is enough, no driving needed (PowerPyx). Getting in one also counts (Push Square), and IGN counts 277 base vehicles (IGN Wiki).

steps.text: Hold D-pad Up for WAiNK and scan passing traffic.
Getting into a vehicle also discovers it.
Check Touch Pad > Progress > Vehicles.
200 of the 277 are needed for 100%, so this comes early.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies in one Combat Focus window (PowerPyx). It reportedly fails on police and soldiers, so use gang members (PowerPyx). Hidden on the PS5 list (Exophase).

steps.text: Buff Focus with food, drinks or a shower; Adrenaline extends it.
Line up 5 gang members at a Gang Operation.
Wear body armor and use an accurate rifle such as the Duke 556.
Raise Focus to level 4 through ranges, golf, pool and fishing.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a passenger plane docked at a VCIA boarding bridge and fly 1 km away (PowerPyx).

steps.text: Planes on the apron do not count; use one at a boarding bridge.
Terminal E3/E4 is easiest: stairs by the bridge lead into the plane.
Go up to the cockpit, reverse to the runway and take off.
Fly 1 km from the airport; the pop is slightly delayed.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino tank from Mile Zero Air Station, south-west Mariana County (PowerPyx). IGN's route uses the base's south stunt jump (IGN Wiki).

steps.text: The tanks stand in the south of Mile Zero Air Station.
The Mile Zero Air Station South stunt jump lands you just west of them.
Bring Adrenaline or body armor; being spotted brings a wanted level.
Get in and fire at enemies until it pops.

sources.label: IGN Wiki
sources.page: How to Get a Rhino Tank

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Needs the Snap Gun from Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs (PowerPyx). Get in quietly, open the safe and kill the cameras and alarm (PowerPyx).

steps.text: Pick the back door with the Snap Gun instead of kicking it.
Find the note with the safe code and open the safe.
Destroy the footage and disable the alarm in the back room.
Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City works well.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 of the 8 large bank vaults and escape; all 8 are needed for 100% (PowerPyx). Chapter 4's That's Where The Money Is… teaches the job (PowerPyx).

steps.text: Finish That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe).
Pay Yasmani $10,000 for security van tips, after two Payday Loans jobs.
Tail the van, rob the open vault, and hand a bag to your partner.
Lose 4 stars on a fast bike, then switch vehicles.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: A large bank vault job counts as an armored truck robbery (PowerPyx). You can also do it earlier by sticky-bombing a truck's back door (PowerPyx).

steps.text: Easiest: a vault job from That's Where The Money Is….
Earlier: block a truck and sticky-bomb its back door.
Yasmani's shop sells sticky bombs after his jobs.
Escape the red heat radius or use a Pay 'n' Spray.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Unfog the whole map; a plane is fastest (PowerPyx). The PS5 trophy tracks 52 areas (Exophase).

steps.text: Take a plane and fly over every black fog patch.
Work in lanes so no corner is left.
Watch the 52-area counter on the PS5 trophy.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: 9 gangs run 39 Illegal Operations; one per gang unlocks this, and 100% needs all 39 (PowerPyx). IGN lists each operation by chapter area (IGN Wiki).

steps.text: Track gangs under Progress > Gangs.
Start with Chapter 1's Fishing Shacks; IGN lists the rest by area.
Yellow map icons mark operations near you.
Do all 39 for the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Buy and drink an Apple Martini at the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach (PowerPyx).

steps.text: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach.
Buy an Apple Martini.
Drink it standing next to the bar.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the south Vice City showroom and drive it through the window; only that car counts (PowerPyx).

steps.text: Get the Key Cloner from Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS in Chapter 3.
Find the blue Banshee in the south Vice City showroom.
Clone it and drive straight through the window.
It pops a little way down the street.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling, Kolt & Associates' operation in Port Gellhorn (IGN Wiki). Bring sticky bombs for the safe (PowerPyx).

steps.text: Kingpin Bowling is south of the Pawn & Gun Ammu-Nation in Port Gellhorn.
Buy sticky bombs at an Ammu-Nation first.
Take the luxury watch, the Gutterball Moreland 850 and the safe.
It pops once you escape the police.
Missed one? The operation comes back later.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Max Strength on Jason and Lucia at once; possible after Coffee Break (PowerPyx).

steps.text: Buy a fitness club membership.
Bring your partner: they train while you train.
Check Touch Pad > Jason & Lucia > Strength.
After the story you can also work out at home.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: 500 actions that change your criminal profile; the PS5 trophy shows the count (Exophase). Most come naturally (PowerPyx).

steps.text: Turn on Criminal Profile HUD notifications.
Robberies and fights all count.
Watch the 500 counter on the PS5 trophy.
Avoid the Irredeemable profile; it is permanent.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: No confirmed method yet; PowerPyx suspects the Prologue Payday Loans store (PowerPyx). Official hint: Second time's the charm (Exophase).

steps.text: PowerPyx lists it as unknown so far.
Leading theory: the Prologue Payday Loans store.
Official hint: Second time's the charm.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: UFO event on the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County, after 2 AM and solo (PowerPyx).

steps.text: Go alone after 2 AM; look for a blinking car at the roadside.
No car? Drive away and come back.
Follow the path into the woods toward the blue light.
Help the woman back to her car.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Kick 10 pedestrians in 60 seconds from a motorbike or bicycle (PowerPyx).

steps.text: Ride a motorbike or bicycle.
Kick 10 pedestrians within 60 seconds.
Use crowded areas such as Ocean Beach.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 in marked bills through fences, counted across all robberies (PowerPyx).

steps.text: Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer.
Rob banks and Payday Loans for marked bills.
Sell to a fence; Yasmani in Vice City pays most.
Bank vaults pay up to $205,000 each.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops (Push Square). Guns, car mods and tattoos cost most (PowerPyx).

steps.text: Find shops via Touch Pad > Style.
Guns, car mods and tattoos are the quickest way to spend.
Spending adds up across every shop.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy the 8 purchasable garages, $160,000 in total, through the Vice City Real Estate app (Push Square). They go on sale after Daily Driver in Chapter 2 (PowerPyx).

steps.text: Finish Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses) in Chapter 2.
Open the Vice City Real Estate app on your phone.
Prices run from $4,000 (Mitchel Auto Center) to $40,000 (Atlantic Court).
The 4 story garages do not count.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to Scooter Bros at a Pay 'n' Spray or Mod Shop (Push Square). The app arrives after Moses in Chapter 2 (PowerPyx).

steps.text: Finish Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses) in Chapter 2.
Buy garages first; each adds parking spots.
Register at a Pay 'n' Spray or Mod Shop.
Cheap cars and bikes keep the fees low.
